reviews.title: 5 star for the price
reviews.comment: Absolutely love this motherboard. The MSI MAG B850 TOMAHAWK MAX WIFI was easy to set up, feels super premium, and has been rock solid with my AM5 build. The Wi-Fi 7 support and DDR5 compatibility make it feel very future-proof, and thermals have been excellent even under load. Plenty of ports, clean BIOS, and overall just a great experience. Definitely a 5 star board for the price.
